title: Formula Teams Unveil Lighter Chassis for New Season
summary: Rule changes push engineers toward smaller, nimbler cars.

body.text: Officials stressed that the plan will be rolled out gradually to avoid disruption.
Analysts say the move could reshape how teams plan their next two years of work.
The hard part was never the technology, it was the coordination.
The team behind the effort credits a small group of volunteers who worked through the summer.
Long term, the impact will depend on adoption by the wider industry.

author.name: Jonas Weber
author.bio: Senior sports writer and former athlete.
